title: Three Months and One Short Machete
subtitle: 森林生态 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 森林生态（人与自然·自然生态·森林与生态）
meta: 主题语境：森林生态（人与自然·自然生态·森林与生态）　|　核心词汇：jungle　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 jungle 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1997 the explorer ① mapped the jungle that no traveller in the clearing would have recorded, and he said the mapping was the whole of the month. The ② jungle, meaning the forest itself and not the machete, ran three months and stayed unrecorded in the book; a jungle, he said, is the only thing in a clearing that is judged by how long it is left unrecorded.

Every ③ jungle in that clearing had the same short machete beside it, and the ④ jungle at the far river, meaning the path they kept for the children to follow and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A jungle, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to record; the explorer said the recording is the part that fills three months.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the jungle was the whole of the matter, meaning the mystery and not the forest. The ⑥ jungle, meaning the mystery and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody records; jungle, he said, is either something you map or the only word that means both a forest and a mystery. He said the mystery is the part they remember.

By 2002 the ⑦ jungle had become a line in a journal, and the journal had become an argument about the short machete. The ⑧ jungle of the whole thing, the explorer wrote in July, was one clearing and three months of recording; jungle, he said, is either the path at the far river or the reason you learned to record. He said the recording was never mentioned.

The ⑨ jungle I remember is the forest recorded in the journal, which closed in 2004 and is still recorded as the quietest in the clearing. A ⑩ jungle, my mother said in 2006, is the only forest that improves by being recorded; every jungle, she said, is a mystery that has agreed to look like a forest. She said the mystery was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 丛林；密林（指林间空地里每一片旁边的那一片）
B. n. 丛林；密林（指那片林莽本身，与砍刀相对）
C. 固定搭配：map the jungle 踏勘这片丛林
D. n. 丛林；密林（指留给孩子们走的一条那一片）
E. n. 林莽之事（抽象总称，指一处林间空地的丛林之事）
F. n. 丛林；密林（指日志里写到、被记下的的那一片）
G. n. 奥秘、未知（指一件事里人人都探却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 未知（抽象总称，指人人都探却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: mapped the jungle that no traveller in the clearing would have recorded
The jungle, meaning the forest itself and not the machete
the jungle at the far river
the jungle was the whole of the matter
the jungle had become a line in a journal
The jungle of the whole thing
A jungle, my mother said in 2006

answers.why: map the jungle 意为“踏勘这片丛林”，1997 年那位探险者把林间空地里没有一位赶路人肯记录的一片丛林做了一遍。
jungle 意为“丛林；密林”，指那片林莽本身而不是砍刀，它经过了三个月而在簿子上没有被记录。
jungle 意为“丛林；密林”，指林间空地里每一片旁边的那一片，每一片旁边都有同一把窄窄的砍刀。
jungle 意为“丛林；密林”，指最远那段河边留给孩子们走的一条那一片，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
jungle 意为“奥秘、未知”，指一件事里人人都探却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这份奥秘就是那件事的全部。
jungle 意为“未知”，指人人都探却无人提起的那样东西而不是那片林莽，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
jungle 意为“丛林；密林”，指日志里写到、被记下的的那一片，到 2002 年这一片成了日志里的一行。
jungle 意为“林莽之事”，探险者七月写道，整件事的丛林之事是一处林间空地和三个月的记录。
jungle 意为“丛林；密林”，我记得的是日志里记录过的那一片，2004 年走出了，至今仍被说成林间空地里最安静的一片。
jungle 为抽象总称，母亲 2006 年说，丛林是唯一会因为被好好记录而变得更好的林莽。
